refreshUnavailable: The refresh operation could not be acknowledged; sign in again
credentialsRequired: An email address and a password are required
passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
refreshUsed: That refresh token has already been used or revoked
passwordChanged: Password changed — every other session was signed out
emailInvalid: Must be a valid email address
tokenNameTooLong: A token name is at most 100 characters
scopeInvalid: A scope is a permission or a pattern such as hello:web:* or *
tooManyScopes: A token carries at most 32 scopes
expiryInvalid: Expiry is a whole number of days between 1 and 365
tokenNeedsSession: API tokens are issued from a signed-in session, not by another token
passwordTooLong: A password can be at most 72 bytes (72 plain letters, fewer with accents or emoji)
